resources.string: Reduces soft shadows on paper while preserving letters.
Balances light and dark areas within the same capture.
Lightens a yellowed or gray document background.
Adaptive black and white for text with uneven lighting.
Smooths grain and small specks without increasing the original resolution.
Sharpens edges. Lower intensities avoid artificial outlines.
Reduces faint marks from the other side of the sheet. Also review faint text and notes.
Apply to pages with text or vectors
By default, these pages keep their original content. When enabled, the page becomes an image; OCR can recreate searchable text.
Pages with text or vectors will also be converted to images when the correction is applied.
Adjust slight tilts to align the document’s lines.
No reliable tilt was found on this page.
The same angle will apply to all pages.
Drag the four corners to the document’s edges. The selected area will be straightened.
The same proportional boundaries will be used on all pages.
Could not open the original capture.
Approximate manual compensation for book pages. Adjust gently and check the result; it does not reconstruct details hidden in the fold.
Reduces image size while keeping good readability.
Stronger compression. Review small text and details before sharing.
Compression is applied when saving. Final size depends on the original file; preserved text and vectors stay sharp when zoomed in.
Recognizes printed text in captures when saving, including Portuguese. Processing happens on the device and preserves the document’s appearance.
OCR can make mistakes and takes longer with long documents. Pages with preserved native text are not recognized again.
Combines image adjustments and uses reliable tilts found during analysis. The result can be compared and undone.
Checks for blank or duplicate pages, blur, low resolution, and possibly cropped content. Alerts are suggestions: no pages are deleted automatically.
Could not complete the analysis. Try again.
No alerts found. We still recommend checking the document before sharing.
